scope: isolated test project only; no historical backfill was attempted

scenarios.case: unregistered shipment with a newly created M3 incident
scenarios.evidence: Incident outbox stayed PENDING with zero attempts before registration; then incident anchor confirmed once after SHIPPER registration.

scenarios.case: incident anchoring after shipment is already registered
scenarios.evidence: Isolated HTTP sequence confirmed registration before the incident anchor; each had one chain confirmation.

scenarios.case: multiple incidents on one shipment wait for registration
scenarios.evidence: Backend regression has two incident events and one sensor-batch event; none is claimable until same-shipment registration is confirmed.
The isolated M3 demo incident had one revision; no recovery mapping exists to exercise revision rebinding.
No historical recovery endpoint or recovery-case model exists. Duplicate same-reference SHIPPER registration requests were tested separately and returned the same event ID.
Authenticated CARRIER registration request returned HTTP 403; no event was created for that request.

scenarios.case: interrupted workflow and recovery after worker restart
scenarios.evidence: With only the isolated worker stopped, two concurrent identical registrations produced one event ID and durable PENDING/0-attempt state; after restart it confirmed once. This was not a historical backfill.
The design-only recovery-to-contract-reference mapping is not implemented. Live inventory remained read-only and unchanged.
Isolated demo shipment retained one Incident ID and one revision after the workflow; duplicate registration did not create an incident.
